webDesignChoices: Finish real supply, same-room self-eating and bedside feeding before tuning hunger or nutrition.
A separate allowFood switch would be a Web extension: disable new supply and bedside feeding without confiscating food or disabling prisoner self-eating.
Retain eater-versus-getter policy semantics from the previous milestone.
Use current room topology and actual physical item placement; a food count or instant hunger refill is not delivery.
Stricter reevaluation of food policy, cell reachability, room ownership or patient state while walking is a Web consistency improvement beyond the bounded native driver.
A strict safe landing-cell solver differs from the generic native random fallback.

Room supply estimation may intentionally check current freshness and prisoner reachability to avoid stale unusable food suppressing every delivery; this improves the coarse native sufficiency estimate.
Projected claims for other incoming deliveries and integration with shared hauling/cooking reservations should avoid duplicate supply without inventing an atomic native room reservation.
Keep physically carried rations on interruption, and make source stack, carried split and dropped ration conserve identity/provenance/quantity through saves.
Original medical feeding, paste dispensers, multi-map rooms and DLC systems remain distinct from a limited Web prisoner supply implementation.
